title: Network Engineer -Office Connect - GCS
description:
At EY, you ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. Job Title: Network Engineer (Office Connect) - GCS Job Summary: The Network Engineer (Office Connect) within Global Connectivity Solutions (GCS) supports vulnerability remediation, lifecycle management, firmware upgrades, and production deployments across enterprise campus network environments. The role executes technical activities involving Cisco Catalyst switching, Cisco wireless infrastructure, Meraki switching, Meraki wireless, and associated network management platforms. The position works with Senior Engineers, Network Engineering, Network Operations, Information Security, Workplace Technology, Change Management, Outage Management, local office teams, and vendors to deliver upgrades safely, troubleshoot implementation issues, and maintain compliance with approved software and operational standards. Job Description Execute vulnerability remediation, firmware upgrades, and software maintenance across Cisco switching, Cisco wireless, Meraki switching, and Meraki wireless platforms. Perform software image validation, pre-upgrade assessments, compatibility checks, post-upgrade verification, and campus device health checks. Support software lifecycle management and platform currency for Cisco Catalyst 9000 Series switches, Cisco Catalyst 9800 Wireless Controllers, Cisco access points, Meraki MS switches, and Meraki MR access points. Assist with device onboarding, configuration validation, testing, migration, hardware refresh, and deployment activities across office locations. Support Layer 2 and Layer 3 technologies including VLANs, trunking, STP/RSTP/MST, EtherChannel/LACP, HSRP/VRRP, ACLs, DHCP Snooping, Dynamic ARP Inspection, port security, and basic routing. Troubleshoot switching issues involving connectivity, VLAN assignment, interfaces, trunks, spanning tree, port channels, routing adjacencies, authentication, software defects, and firmware upgrades. Support wireless operations including SSID validation, access point onboarding, controller and AP upgrades, RF troubleshooting, coverage verification, roaming analysis, and wireless client connectivity. Apply knowledge of 802.11ac, 802.11ax (Wi-Fi 6), and Wi-Fi 6E during compatibility validation, implementation, and troubleshooting activities. Use Cisco Catalyst Center, Catalyst Center Assurance, Meraki Dashboard, wireless analytics, monitoring tools, logs, and packet captures for visibility, compliance tracking, and troubleshooting. Participate in testing and validation of integrations with identity, security, endpoint, print, and workplace technology services. Prepare implementation procedures, rollback steps, test plans, validation documents, change tasks, technical runbooks, and implementation records. Participate in CAB preparation and support Senior Engineers during technical change reviews when required. Execute approved changes during maintenance windows and provide timely implementation updates to technical leads and stakeholders. Troubleshoot issues arising from firmware upgrades, software changes, hardware replacements, or configuration modifications. Escalate complex issues with accurate diagnostics, logs, packet captures, impact details, and actions completed. Participate in outage calls, incident recovery, technical investigation, root cause analysis, and resolution validation. Support access point refreshes, switch migrations, office network upgrades, remediation waves, and campus modernization initiatives. Maintain network inventory, software versions, vulnerability status, compliance evidence, upgrade history, and deployment outcomes. Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, compliance validation, inventory improvement, monitoring, and reporting. Knowledge & Competencies Required: Hands-on knowledge of Cisco Catalyst 9000 Series switching and enterprise Layer 2/Layer 3 campus technologies. Working knowledge of Cisco Catalyst 9800 Wireless Controllers, Cisco access points, wireless operations, and firmware lifecycle activities. Working knowledge of Meraki MS Switching, Meraki MR Wireless, Meraki Dashboard administration, device onboarding, firmware management, wireless health, and client analytics. Understanding of VLANs, trunking, STP/RSTP/MST, EtherChannel/LACP, HSRP/VRRP, ACLs, DHCP Snooping, Dynamic ARP Inspection, port security, and basic routing. Understanding of wireless fundamentals including RF behavior, channel utilization, interference, coverage, capacity, roaming, authentication, and client troubleshooting. Working knowledge of Wi-Fi standards including 802.11ac, 802.11ax (Wi-Fi 6), and Wi-Fi 6E. Experience using Cisco Catalyst Center, Catalyst Center Assurance, Meraki Dashboard, monitoring tools, logs, and packet captures. Experience supporting vulnerability remediation, firmware upgrades, configuration changes, hardware refreshes, or campus modernization activities. Strong troubleshooting discipline and ability to collect, interpret, and document technical evidence. Working knowledge of Change, Incident, Problem, Risk, and Release Management practices. Good implementation planning, validation, documentation, communication, and collaboration skills. Knowledge of network monitoring, observability, analytics, and automation platforms. Basic scripting or automation knowledge using APIs, Python, Ansible, Catalyst Center, or Meraki APIs is desirable. Strong ownership, attention to detail, compliance focus, and continuous improvement mindset. Willingness to work in a global support model, including rotational shifts and support across multiple time zones. Flexibility to support maintenance, deployments, upgrades, remediation, and incident recovery outside regular business hours when required. Ready to travel when required and collaborate with globally distributed teams, vendors, service providers, and stakeholders. Job Requirements: Education: Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related technical discipline Experience: Minimum of 3-6 years of experience in enterprise campus network engineering, switching, wireless, or related network technology support. Certification Requirements: CCNA preferred. Cisco Wireless, Meraki ECMS, Catalyst Center, and ITIL v4 Foundation certifications are value adds. EY | Building a better working world EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Network Engineer
description:
Job Description I&O Platform Infrastructure Network Engineer Supervising Associate | Enterprise Technology   The opportunity In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology we are looking for a proven Network Engineer to support and evolve EY's global data center and enterprise network infrastructure. The role will provide engineering, operational support, automation and lifecycle management across EY's campus, data center and wide-area network environments. The successful candidate will work with cutting-edge networking technologies with a specific focus on routing and switching, data center fabric, network security, SD-WAN, load balancing and network automation.   Your key responsibilities The I&O Platform Infrastructure Network Engineer provides technical support and engineering of complex nature for the firm's global enterprise network platforms. This professional applies knowledge of multi-vendor routing and switching, data center networking, network security, WAN technologies and automation tooling to support enterprise-scale connectivity and availability. The role requires in-depth knowledge of the firm's network architecture to implement platform enhancements, lifecycle management activities, patching programs, security initiatives and operational improvements. The engineer will assist in maintaining highly available, high-performance network environments across global data center and office locations while ensuring compliance, resiliency and operational excellence.   Skills and attributes for success Strong experience designing and administering enterprise data center and campus network environments. Deep knowledge of routing protocols including BGP, OSPF, EIGRP and IS-IS. Strong Layer 2 switching experience including VLANs, STP, RSTP, MSTP and VPC/MLAG. Experience with Cisco, Arista or Juniper data center switching platforms (exclusionary). Experience maintaining mission-critical production network environments in a global data center setting (exclusionary). Experience supporting SD-WAN platforms (Cisco Viptela, VMware VeloCloud or equivalent). Strong knowledge of network security technologies including: Firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco ASA/FTD, Fortinet or equivalent) Network Access Control (NAC) IDS/IPS VPN — IPsec and SSL/TLS Microsegmentation Experience with data center fabric technologies including: VXLAN EVPN Spine-leaf architecture ACI or equivalent SDN platforms Experience with load balancing platforms (F5 BIG-IP, Citrix ADC or equivalent). Knowledge of DNS, DHCP and IPAM (DDI) management. Experience with network automation and Infrastructure-as-Code tooling including: Ansible Python / Netmiko / NAPALM Terraform Experience with network monitoring and observability platforms (SolarWinds, PRTG, ThousandEyes or equivalent). Ability to create technical documentation, network diagrams and operational runbooks. Strong working knowledge of DevOps, Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks. Ability to work effectively with clients, management and global engineering teams.   To qualify for the role, you must have experience with Enterprise routing and switching administration — 5–7 years. BGP, OSPF and other dynamic routing protocol configuration and troubleshooting — 5–7 years. Data center switching platforms (Cisco Nexus, Arista EOS, Juniper QFX or equivalent) — 5–7 years. Layer 2 technologies including VLANs, VPC, MLAG, STP and trunking — 5–7 years. Enterprise firewall administration (Palo Alto, Cisco FTD, Fortinet or equivalent) — 5–7 years. SD-WAN deployment and operational management — 3–5 years. VXLAN/EVPN data center fabric design and administration. Spine-leaf architecture deployment and operations. F5 BIG-IP LTM/GTM load balancer administration. IPsec and SSL VPN configuration and troubleshooting. DDI management (DNS, DHCP, IPAM). Network automation scripting using Python, Ansible or equivalent. Network change management, patching and firmware lifecycle management. Network monitoring, alerting and capacity management. Packet capture and traffic analysis (Wireshark, tcpdump or equivalent). Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity planning for network platforms. Security hardening and vulnerability remediation of network infrastructure. Cloud networking fundamentals — Azure Virtual Network, AWS VPC or equivalent. Hybrid connectivity including ExpressRoute, Direct Connect or equivalent (preferred).   Ideally, you'll also have Cisco CCNP (Enterprise, Data Center or Security) certification (desired). Arista ACE certification (desired). Palo Alto PCNSE certification (desired). Juniper JNCIP certification (better to have). F5 201 / 301 certification (better to have). ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary). Cisco CCIE (Enterprise Infrastructure or Data Center) — better to have. Experience with network telemetry and streaming (gNMI, gRPC, OpenConfig). Experience with Cisco ACI or VMware NSX SDN platforms. Familiarity with zero-trust network access (ZTNA) frameworks and implementation.   What we look for An experienced and technically strong network engineer to help build, maintain and modernize EY's global enterprise network infrastructure. We are looking for an individual with deep multi-vendor networking expertise, a passion for automation and security, and the ability to support highly available, high-performance network platforms while driving continuous operational improvement across EY's data center and wide-area network estate.

title: Senior L2 Network Engineer  NOC
description:
Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Senior L2 Network Engineer to join our NOC team, responsible for advanced troubleshooting, configuration, and maintenance of large-scale IP/MPLS backbone and service provider networks. The candidate will act as the escalation point for L1 engineers, lead incident/problem management, and drive network stability, performance, and change management across multi-vendor environments. Key Responsibilities Act as the primary L2/L3 escalation point for complex network incidents raised by the NOC L1 team. Perform end-to-end troubleshooting of IP/MPLS core, aggregation, and access network issues. Configure, monitor, and maintain routers, switches, and MPLS PE/P/CE devices across the network. Own Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for major/critical incidents and prepare detailed RCA reports. Plan and execute network changes, upgrades, and maintenance activities (MOPs) with minimal service impact. Monitor network health using NMS/EMS tools; proactively identify and resolve performance degradation. Coordinate with vendors (Cisco/Juniper/Nokia/Huawei/Arista TAC) for hardware/software escalations. Maintain network documentation, topology diagrams, SOPs, and configuration backups. Mentor and guide L1/L2 engineers; conduct knowledge transfer and training sessions. Ensure adherence to SLA, KPI, and uptime targets defined by the organization/customer. Experience with network monitoring tools (NMS/EMS SolarWinds, Nagios, Zabbix, vendor-specific EMS). Incident, Problem, and Change Management (ITIL process exposure). Strong analytical and packet-level troubleshooting ability (Wireshark, packet capture analysis). Excellent communication skills for customer/vendor escalation handling.
